Peptides for weight loss

Two peptide drugs are FDA approved for weight management and need a prescription. Compounded copies and newer molecules sold online are not approved.

  • Semaglutide (Wegovy)FDA approved, prescription
  • Tirzepatide (Zepbound)FDA approved, prescription
  • Compounded semaglutide or tirzepatideNot FDA approved; pharmacy-made
  • RetatrutideNot approved; still in trials

Peptides for muscle and hormones

No peptide is FDA approved for building muscle. Tesamorelin is approved for one specific use in people with HIV; growth hormone peptides sold for muscle are not approved.

  • Tesamorelin (Egrifta)FDA approved for HIV-related belly fat only
  • SermorelinNo FDA-approved product on the market
  • CJC-1295 / ipamorelinNot approved for any use

How we rate

Every product and seller is judged on the same five criteria. We publish them so you can check our work.

Read the full method

  • Evidence

    What human studies show for the use you care about, not what a molecule does in a dish.

  • Regulatory status

    FDA approval, cosmetic or research labeling, and any FDA warning letters sent to the seller.

  • Lab testing

    Whether a third-party certificate of analysis exists and matches the batch you would receive.

  • Real price

    Price per month or per milligram, calculated the same way for every seller so the numbers compare.

  • Transparency

    Who runs the company, where it ships from, and whether paid placements are labeled.
